components.name: Button
components.doc: Ref-forwarding so it can anchor Radix triggers (Dropdown/Popover asChild).

components.name: ChargeRing
components.doc: Circular arc showing 1 − quiet/cadence: full = fresh, empty = overdue. Magnitude, so it is a sequential scale: one hue (Delegate yellow) stepping down in opacity, never a hue ramp. The three off-token blues and browns this used to fade through read as *categories* rather than as less-of-the-same, and none of them were tokens. The arc length carries the value on its own, the caller is still expected to print the number beside it.

props.name: quiet
props.doc: Days since last interaction.

props.name: cadence
props.doc: Cadence target in days.

props.name: align
props.doc: Where the box sits against the label. Default centres it, which reads well for a one-line label and badly for a wrapped paragraph, so multi-line labels pass 'start' to keep the box on the first line.

components.name: ChipGroup
components.doc: A wrapping run of chips. This is `.chips`.

components.name: ClosenessDots
components.doc: Closeness as a row of dots. The dots used to carry the whole reading in one colour channel, with the number itself only in a `title` on a span, which is not a reliable place to put anything. The dots are decoration now and the value is stated in text: visible where there is room for it, and spoken either way.

props.name: showValue
props.doc: Print the count beside the dots as well as announcing it.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name for the input and its list. Required: an unnamed control is announced as "edit blank". Match the visible label when there is one.

props.name: query
props.doc: The current text. Owned by the caller, this component never edits it.

props.name: value
props.doc: The chosen item's value, marked with a check and the word "Selected".

props.name: open
props.doc: Controlled popup state. Omit to let the component own it.

props.name: loading
props.doc: A search is in flight. Announced, and never mistaken for "no results".

props.name: error
props.doc: The search failed. Rendered as an alert, not as an empty list.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.doc: Shown when a typed query matched nothing. Pass `null` to show nothing.

props.name: openOnFocus
props.doc: Open the list when the input takes focus. Default true.

props.name: keepOpenOnSelect
props.doc: Stay open after a pick, for inputs that collect several values.

props.name: onInputKeyDown
props.doc: Runs before the built-in key handling. Call `preventDefault()` to take a key over entirely (a tag input claiming Backspace, say).

props.name: title
props.doc: Accessible name for the dialog (announced on open).

props.name: className
props.doc: Extra class on the panel (e.g. 'overlay--wide').

props.name: days
props.doc: Oldest → newest; true = checked.

props.name: recentWindow
props.doc: Highlight the most recent N days in full color; older checked days dim.

props.name: label
props.doc: What the grid counts, e.g. "Deep work". Without it the grid stays hidden from assistive tech, which is what it was before, a silent 30 dots.

props.name: detail
props.doc: Compatibility alias for hint in task-oriented workspace states.

props.name: glyph
props.doc: Override the glyph for something that isn't a node type, a reminder, a saved view. Without it the type map falls back to 'dot' and the tile's title lies about what the row is.

props.name: action
props.doc: A second way out, beside Retry: reload the page, go somewhere that still works, open the readable twin of a canvas that failed. Callers were rebuilding `vt-error` by hand to get one, which forks the role, the heading and the spacing along with it.

props.name: scale
props.doc: Denominator for widths. Pass the best score in the set so bars compare across rows instead of each stretching to its own maximum.

props.name: label
props.doc: Names the whole bar for assistive tech, e.g. "Score 1.84".

props.name: label
props.doc: Names the set, e.g. "Filter people". Announced before the buttons.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible label for the trigger (defaults to "More information").

props.name: triggerLabel
props.doc: Trigger label; defaults to a "How this works" pill.

components.name: LogoHorizontal
components.doc: Horizontal lockup: mark + "Vitae" wordmark (Archivo Black, caps, -0.035em tracking, the .u-display treatment). Wordmark is real text so it uses the self-hosted face and stays crisp at any density.

props.name: markSize
props.doc: Height of the mark; the wordmark scales with it.

components.name: LogoMark
components.doc: The primary mark. Never stretched, sheared, or rotated.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Colour variant: 'primary' (yellow/deleg) | 'secondary' (ink) | 'inherit' (currentColor)

components.name: LogoStacked
components.doc: Stacked lockup for sign-in / empty states.

props.name: markSize
props.doc: Height of the mark; the wordmark scales with it.

components.name: Menu
components.section: Menu (dropdown with grouped items, keyboard nav from Radix)

props.name: columns
props.doc: Lay groups out side-by-side (wide catalogs like the 28-type picker).

props.name: titleAccessory
props.doc: Extra content beside the title (chips, provenance).

props.name: amountKey
props.doc: Key of the numeric part (role.comp uses 'base').

components.name: Mono
components.doc: Monospace, tabular text, the identity's face for data. Spreads the rest of its props onto the span. It used to accept only `children`, `className` and `style`, so a caller adding `role="status"` or an `aria-label` had it silently dropped, the same trap Select had, and the reason `Input` and `Textarea` spread theirs. A primitive that quietly discards an accessibility attribute is worse than one that refuses it.

props.name: help
props.doc: Pass an <InfoPopover/> (or any node) for contextual help.

props.name: actions
props.doc: Primary action(s), right-aligned (e.g. a "New résumé" button).

components.name: Rating
components.section: Rating (1-5 dots: ClosenessDots visual language, interactive)

props.name: activeIndex
props.doc: Index into `ticks` that is "here". Only this tick takes the accent.

props.name: label
props.doc: What the ticks mean, e.g. "Days of this week". Required when ticks exist.

props.name: meta
props.doc: Rendered in mono beside the title, a count, a total.

props.name: actions
props.doc: Right-aligned controls for this region only.

props.name: label
props.doc: Names the control for assistive tech. Radix renders the trigger as a `<button role="combobox">`, and a `<label for>` does not name a button, so a Select used on its own had no accessible name (axe: `button-name`). Required when no visible label sits beside it in the accessibility tree.

props.name: 'aria-label'
props.doc: Forwarded to the trigger. Input and Textarea spread rest props; Select used to drop them, so `aria-label="Status filter"` looked labelled in source and was unlabeled in the browser.

props.name: count
props.doc: Compatibility alias used by workspace skeletons. `rows` wins.

props.name: label
props.doc: What is being waited for, in the user's words.

components.name: SkeletonText
components.doc: N stacked text lines, the last one shorter.

components.name: Spread
components.doc: Two ends of a line, space between. This is `.spread`.

components.name: StatusTrace
components.doc: A compact textual + visual state signal for the Living Ledger. The line and node echo a record moving through a trace, but the label is always present and carries the meaning. Its motion runs once when the state mounts; it never loops, pulses, or pretends that idle work is progressing.

props.name: label
props.doc: Short state text: "Refreshing records", "Draft saved".

props.name: detail
props.doc: Optional evidence, timestamp, or stage counter.

props.name: announce
props.doc: Set false when a surrounding live region already announces the state.

props.name: label
props.doc: What the number means, e.g. "tie strength". Kept short and free of the row's subject: the row already announces who it is, so repeating the name in every cell is verbose to a screen reader, and it made the name match twice for any test querying by text.

components.name: StrengthDonut
components.section: StrengthDonut (person page, strength with decomposition ring)

props.name: strength
props.doc: 0..1 overall tie strength.

components.name: Tabs
components.doc: A tab strip with the roles and the keyboard the pattern requires: one tab stop for the whole strip (roving tabindex), arrows to move between tabs, Home/End to reach the ends. The six hand-rolled strips in the app were runs of plain buttons, so a keyboard user tabbed through every one of them and a screen reader was never told which was current. Selection follows focus, which is the right choice when the panel is already rendered and switching costs nothing.

props.name: duration
props.doc: Milliseconds before auto dismiss. Radix pauses this on hover and focus.

props.name: swipeAxis
props.doc: Which axis the swipe offset follows; set by the provider.

props.name: className
props.doc: Compatibility hook for an application migrating an existing selector.

props.name: announcementMode
props.doc: Provider-controlled compatibility mode; prefer the default Radix announcer.

props.name: swipeDirection
props.doc: Direction a pointer swipe dismisses in. Defaults to the viewport corner.

props.name: itemClassName
props.doc: Applied to every toast while a host app migrates legacy selectors.

props.name: announcementMode
props.doc: `radix` uses Radix's delayed, portalled announcer. `item` keeps legacy role=status/alert selectors on the visible item while preserving the queue, focus pause, hotkey, and swipe behavior.

hooks.name: useAnimatedNumber
hooks.doc: The value to render right now, easing toward `target` whenever `target` changes. Returns `target` verbatim on first render, under reduced motion, where the document reports no --ae-dur, and anywhere requestAnimationFrame is missing: a value appearing is not a value changing, and there is nothing to report.

hooks.name: useReducedMotion
hooks.doc: True while the user has asked the system for reduced motion. Re-renders when the preference changes, if the platform lets us hear about it.

hooks.name: useToast
hooks.doc: Fire a toast. Must be called under a <ToastProvider>.
